name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private two-track terminus retry using native-stop-style internal lightrail paths.
description: Revision 16 replaces the rejected root-STREET switch layout of revision 15. The log gave no specific rejection reason. This retry follows the native underground-stop architecture: one short straight double STREET approach and internal vehicle lanes with the four measured tram/railtram modes, reservation and both directions. Terminals bind to separate internal platform midpoints. Crossover is enabled by default and can be disabled for comparison. Existing rail and buffer models are decorative; the infrastructure remains tram-based. No overlapping reverse curves or automatic commands. Native placement, internal routing with these modes, both platform routes and crossing safety are still unproven. First test: place one isolated station and run ten seconds. Existing working single-track stations and profiles are unchanged.
